title: Apache upstream-integration adapters rejected their own task-local runtime contract
title_de: Apache-Upstream-Integrationsadapter lehnten ihren eigenen task-lokalen Runtime-Vertrag ab
security_assessment: No production vulnerability was validated. The defects prevented required fail-closed Apache body and Valgrind evidence from reaching their legitimate environment prerequisites; the Parent-only repairs preserve scope and path containment.
protocol: Parent Apache request-body regression and Valgrind soak adapters
profile: Selective upstream PR #91–#94 integration task, Parent branch codex/apache-upstream-pr-91-94-integration
summary: The initial Parent request-body adapter supplied a task-local absolute case to the Framework case selector without registering the allowed external case root, so selection failed before Apache startup. The initial soak adapter reused POSIX-shell global variable names across nested helpers and therefore reduced its validated external root to `/`. Both Parent-only defects are fixed and rerun to their next legitimate fail-closed prerequisite.
summary_de: Der anfängliche Parent-Request-Body-Adapter übergab dem Framework-Case-Selector eine task-lokale absolute Case-Datei, ohne den zulässigen externen Case-Root zu registrieren, sodass die Auswahl vor dem Apache-Start fehlschlug. Der anfängliche Soak-Adapter verwendete POSIX-Shell-globale Variablennamen in verschachtelten Helpern erneut und reduzierte deshalb seinen validierten externen Root auf `/`. Beide Parent-eigenen Defekte sind behoben und bis zu ihrer nächsten legitimen fehlgeschlossenen Voraussetzung erneut ausgeführt.
observed_behavior: The request-body runner failed with `ValueError: smoke case is outside selected scope` for its generated external YAML. The soak runner then attempted `mkdir` under `//apache-soak-*`; an xtrace showed that nested helpers had overwritten the caller's `candidate` variable while walking ancestors. These failures occurred before Apache or Valgrind instrumentation could begin.
observed_behavior_de: Der Request-Body-Runner schlug für seine generierte externe YAML mit `ValueError: smoke case is outside selected scope` fehl. Der Soak-Runner versuchte anschließend `mkdir` unter `//apache-soak-*`; ein xtrace zeigte, dass verschachtelte Helper beim Durchlaufen der Vorfahren die `candidate`-Variable des Callers überschrieben hatten. Diese Fehler traten auf, bevor Apache- oder Valgrind-Instrumentierung beginnen konnte.
expected_behavior: A task-local explicit case is admitted only through the Framework-supported `EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS` boundary with the narrow no-CRS selection required by its fixture. A validated external soak root stays unchanged across nested shell helpers, remains outside source checkouts, and receives a bounded report before any unavailable tool is reported as blocked.
expected_behavior_de: Eine task-lokale explizite Case-Datei wird nur über die Framework-unterstützte `EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS`-Grenze mit der für ihr Fixture engen No-CRS-Auswahl zugelassen. Ein validierter externer Soak-Root bleibt über verschachtelte Shell-Helper unverändert, bleibt außerhalb der Source-Checkouts und erhält einen begrenzten Bericht, bevor ein fehlendes Tool als blockiert gemeldet wird.
impact: The adapter failures hid the genuine prerequisites and prevented meaningful request-body and memory-safety evidence. They did not alter production Apache behavior, bypass a gate, or create an observed security exploit. After repair, both paths fail closed only at their actual missing prerequisites.
impact_de: Die Adapterfehler verdeckten die echten Voraussetzungen und verhinderten aussagekräftige Request-Body- und Memory-Safety-Evidence. Sie änderten weder produktives Apache-Verhalten noch umgingen sie ein Gate oder erzeugten einen beobachteten Security-Exploit. Nach der Reparatur schlagen beide Pfade nur noch an ihren tatsächlichen fehlenden Voraussetzungen fehlgeschlossen fehl.
preconditions: A Parent-owned generated Apache request-body case is outside Framework source roots.
The Parent soak runner is given an absolute task-owned APACHE_SOAK_ROOT.
The Parent harness uses the existing Framework case CLI without Framework source changes.
reproduction: Run the request-body target before registering its generated configuration directory through EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS and observe the selected-scope error.
Run the soak target before separating nested helper variables and observe a //apache-soak-* run path in its blocked output.

Apply the narrow Parent repair and rerun the same targets: request-body must resolve the external case and then block on the unavailable httpd; both soak modes must write bounded external reports and then block on unavailable Valgrind.

evidence.command: Focused static wiring checks plus rerun of the Parent request-body and memcheck/helgrind adapter entry points

root_cause: The request-body adapter assumed an arbitrary absolute case was in scope, although Framework intentionally accepts external cases only through EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS. The soak script used global POSIX-shell variables named candidate in prepare_external_directory, require_absolute_path, and reject_symlink_ancestors; the nested ancestor walk therefore changed the outer caller's path to `/`.
root_cause_de: Der Request-Body-Adapter nahm an, dass eine beliebige absolute Case-Datei im Scope sei, obwohl Framework externe Cases absichtlich nur über EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS akzeptiert. Das Soak-Skript verwendete globale POSIX-Shell-Variablen namens candidate in prepare_external_directory, require_absolute_path und reject_symlink_ancestors; der verschachtelte Vorfahrenlauf änderte dadurch den äußeren Caller-Pfad auf `/`.
proposed_remediation: Set exactly the generated configuration directory as EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS and select the fixture through the no-CRS baseline without changing Framework. Use distinct variables for the outer directory, path validator, and ancestor walker; retain the absolute-path, symlink, source-checkout, and bounded-artifact controls. Guard both contracts with Parent static tests.
proposed_remediation_de: Genau das generierte Konfigurationsverzeichnis als EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS setzen und das Fixture über die No-CRS-Baseline auswählen, ohne Framework zu ändern. Unterschiedliche Variablen für äußeres Verzeichnis, Pfadvalidator und Vorfahrenläufer verwenden; die Kontrollen für absolute Pfade, Symlinks, Source-Checkouts und begrenzte Artefakte beibehalten. Beide Verträge mit Parent-Static-Tests absichern.
acceptance_criteria: The generated external request-body YAML resolves through the existing Framework interface with CASE_SCOPE=all, EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS restricted to its configuration directory, and the required no-CRS baseline.
The soak runner preserves a valid APACHE_SOAK_ROOT through nested helper calls and never creates or attempts to create a run directory at / or //apache-soak-*.
Focused Parent wiring tests and shell syntax checks pass.
The original entry points are rerun and reach only their legitimate fail-closed Apache or Valgrind prerequisite blockers.
Framework, MRTS, Gitlinks, Docker/Compose assets, and production request-body handler architecture remain unchanged.
validation_plan: Run one request-body mode and both soak modes with explicit task-owned external roots.
When a prepared Apache runtime and Valgrind are available, run the full body-mode family and native Memcheck/Helgrind evidence workflow.
legitimate_control_tests: The external request-body case prints a resolved path and reaches Apache prerequisite validation rather than selected-scope rejection.
Memcheck and Helgrind each write a bounded external report/upload bundle before truthfully reporting unavailable Valgrind.
The existing absolute-path, symlink, source-checkout, and artifact-budget safeguards remain required.
dependencies: A prepared Parent Apache runtime and Valgrind for native evidence
blocked_by: Native Apache request-body and Valgrind evidence remain blocked by missing local prerequisites; this does not reopen the verified adapter defect.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-PARENT-0041: that record concerns an unsupported Framework helper CLI option in the Phase-4 harness. This record concerns the independently observed extra-case-root and POSIX shell-variable contracts in the upstream PR #91–#94 adapters.
residual_risk: The original adapter defects are verified repaired at their strongest locally available preflight stage. Native request-body, Memcheck, and Helgrind evidence remains unavailable because the task environment lacks the prepared Apache runtime and Valgrind; no runtime success, leak freedom, or race freedom is claimed.
residual_risk_de: Die ursprünglichen Adapterdefekte sind in ihrer stärksten lokal verfügbaren Preflight-Stufe als repariert verifiziert. Native Request-Body-, Memcheck- und Helgrind-Evidence bleibt nicht verfügbar, weil der Task-Umgebung der vorbereitete Apache-Runtime und Valgrind fehlen; es wird kein Runtime-Erfolg, keine Leak-Freiheit und keine Race-Freiheit behauptet.

history.detail: The generated request-body case was outside Framework selected scope and the soak runner reduced its validated root to / through a global shell-variable collision.

Parent-only EXTRA_CASE_ROOTS/no-CRS wiring and distinct soak helper variables passed focused tests. The original entry points now reach only absent httpd and Valgrind prerequisites; no Framework/MRTS change occurred.
